description.value: At 3rd level, a gambler strikes a pact with Lady Luck, unlocking access to a fabled currency known as 'MGP,' or 'Manderville Gold Saucer Points.' The gambler begins play with an amount of MGP equal to his Charisma modifier (minimum 1) x his gambler level. The total MGP a gambler can possess at any time is equal to his gambler level x 10. The gambler can repair or replace damaged throwing cards by expending 1 MGP for every three cards fixed or replaced. The gambler can accrue additional MGP via Bet (wagering MGP up to his Charisma modifier once per round as a free action on the outcome of a visible creature's d20 check) or Buy In (converting gil into MGP as a standard action when his reserves are empty, at 10 gil per 1 MGP, up to a maximum equal to his Charisma modifier).
